apps.name: Deck
apps.subtitle: Wardrive HUD for WDGWars
apps.localizedDescription: Deck is a native iPhone wardriving HUD for WDGWars. Dark neon map, live territory grid, capture progress (Confirmed/Needed), and turn-by-turn while you drive. Sign in with your WDGWars API key (or username + password via the documented login route). Unsigned; Feather signs on-device.

versions.localizedDescription: No demo mode. Apple Maps-style location button. Multiple scanners with cross-device dedupe; only Wi-Fi with valid GPS counts.

appPermissions.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Deck shows your position on the WDGWars grid, the square you are in, and turn-by-turn directions while you drive.

news.title: Deck 1.0.3
news.caption: No demo mode, Apple Maps-style location button, multiple scanners with dedupe and GPS-only Wi-Fi counting.

news.title: Deck 1.0.2
news.caption: Cell tap popup, compact neon HUD, Held by <gang>, Nets needed to capture (Confirmed/Needed), and no more 'Network error: cancelled'.
